 HoopsHype Nov. 9, 2026, 4:36 a.m. ET Bones Hyland said he welcomes the challenge of facing elite perimeter defenders, while explaining how Minnesota’s ball movement and depth have fueled its four-game winning streak. “Honestly, I think it’s a sign of respect,” Hyland said after the Timberwolves beat the Utah Jazz 115-100 on Sunday. “I’m always being guarded by the best defender when I check in. But I thrive and I love it.”
